text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: sustained p95/p99 token latency increase on streaming endpoints in us-west. Errors stable but backend queue depth up, clients timing out on long streams. Auto-scaler hasn't caught up.
jamie: paging @priya (oncall), can you confirm and take lead?
priya: on it. seeing continuous tail lat rise starting ~10:02 UTC, CPU on model-hosts plateauing, router queues growing. non-streaming (sync) routes OK.
oliver: hey quick thought — if we temporarily stop server-push streaming (SSE/websocket chunking) clients will fall back to poll/sync and that should drop sustained load. can we flip a feature-flag?
priya: yes. prefer graceful: set short rollout window, move traffic from streaming to non-streaming endpoints, and keep an eye on per-token cost.
matt: agree. need to coordinate with CS for any impacted customers using long-lived streams. @cs-lead pls prepare a brief note.
priya: taking action plan: 1) set streaming feature-flag to `off` for hosted tier in us-west 2) adjust per-route rate-limits to protect control-plane 3) update dashboard + status page 4) monitor.
jamie: commands (internal FF API):
```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/flags/streaming" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"state":"off","scope":"hosted:us-west","reason":"live-mitigation-latency-spike"}'
```
priya: running the curl now (will wait 5s to confirm).
deploy-bot: Feature-flag update queued by priya; checking policy allowlist... OK.
priya: flag rolled off for hosted:us-west. rolling over 30s.
oliver: switching router rule to route streaming requests to non-streaming handler for compatibility fallback. patch applied.
priya: verifying metrics — token throughput dropped ~28%, queue depth falling. tail latency improving but still elevated at p99.
matt: good. CS note: @cs-lead please post to the accounts with active streaming sessions: short blurb, estimated window ~30-45m, degrade to sync responses.
cs-lead: drafting now. will send brief with guidance and a link to the incident channel.
jamie: oncall handoff: priya will continue active mitigation, oliver will watch routing, matt will hold customer comms, jamie standby to escalate.
priya: monitoring logs for errors from fallback handlers. so far, small spike in 429s on sync endpoints — I'm bumping rate-limits on the control plane by +10% for tenant blacklists.
oliver: also enabling short-term cache TTL extension for common prefixes to reduce model load.
priya: if latency steadies in next 10m we'll keep flag off and gradually restore streaming with canary 1% then 10%.
jamie: @incident-bot, create incident ticket and page infra oncall if p99 doesn't drop below target in 20m.
incident-bot: Incident ticket #INC-2026 created; paging infra oncall if SLA not met.
priya: noted. continuing to monitor. status updates every 5m or on new events. :white_check_mark:
